question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The Padma Multipurpose Bridge, the longest bridge in Bangladesh, was inaugurated on 25 June 2022. This dreamy bridge is mainly constructed with steel and concrete. The length of the main bridge is 6.15 km and the width is 18.18 meters with two layers-a four lane road at the top and a railway at the bottom. The bridge connects Mawa in Munshiganj to Jajira in Shariatpur district. It will also be used for gas, power lines and fiber optic cable expansion in the future. The bridge will play a great role both in communication and economic development of Bangladesh.
